newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan may invite bids to import 50,000 T sugar.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan may invite bids to import 50,000 T sugar.

text.p: The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan (TCP) is likely to invite bids in the next few days for the import of 50,000 tonnes of refined crystal white sugar, one official of the corporation said.
"The bids will be invited soon after we get a green signal from Islamabad, likely later today," said one official, who asked not to be named.
The TCP had so far purchased 225,000 tonnes of sugar mainly from India on government-to-government level, the official said.
He said the private sector had also imported some sugar but did not know the quantity.
One dealer said more than six cargoes of sugar had been booked by the private sector for delivery by October but it was not confirmed by the official.
